blocks.text: Geneva, Switzerland—The El Nino weather phenomenon gripping the planet could be off the charts, the United Nations (UN) warned Wednesday, October 21, saying countries should take urgent action to prepare for the worst. “The current El Nino event could be unprecedented in strength. Literally off the monitoring charts that we have used for the past four decades,” Celeste Saulo, head of the UN’s World Meteorological Organization, told a press conference in Geneva. “El Nino will peak towards the end of 2026, but its impacts will be felt long after that.” READ: El Nino update: The impacts around the world this week She said […]...
